Verify by copying the text back out of the file.

output: Use relative estimates with qualifiers: "served 10K+ users", "reduced response time by approx. 30%", "scaled to handle 3x traffic", "led a team of 4", "automated a task saving 2 hours/week". output: ATS systems struggle with tables, graphics, headers/footers and unusual fonts. Verify by copying the text back out of the file.

history.content: How do I add numbers to my CV if I don't have exact metrics?

Use relative estimates with qualifiers: "served 10K+ users", "reduced response time by approx. 30%", "scaled to handle 3x traffic", "led a team of 4", "automated a task saving 2 hours/week". history.content: Will an ATS read my CV correctly? Any formatting tips?

ATS systems struggle with tables, graphics, headers/footers and unusual fonts. Use: (1) standard section titles — Summary, Experience, Education, Skills; (2) a single-column layout; (3) standard fonts like Arial or Calibri; (4) spell out acronyms at least once; (5) .docx or PDF (not images). Verify by copying the text back out of the file.

input: Will an ATS read my CV correctly? Any formatting tips?
output: ATS systems struggle with tables, graphics, headers/footers and unusual fonts. Use: (1) standard section titles — Summary, Experience, Education, Skills; (2) a single-column layout; (3) standard fonts like Arial or Calibri; (4) spell out acronyms at least once; (5) .docx or PDF (not images). Verify by copying the text back out of the file.

input: What is the best structure for a one-page CV?
output: Top to bottom: (1) header with name, title, email, phone, LinkedIn; (2) 2-3 sentence summary; (3) core skills as comma-separated keywords; (4) experience, most recent first, 3-5 bullets per job with metrics; (5) education at the end; (6) optional certifications. Skip the "References available on request" line. Recruiters decide in about 6 seconds — make your fit obvious immediately.

Top to bottom: (1) header with name, title, email, phone, LinkedIn; (2) 2-3 sentence summary; (3) core skills as comma-separated keywords; (4) experience, most recent first, 3-5 bullets per job with metrics; (5) education at the end; (6) optional certifications. history.content: How do I add numbers to my CV if I don't have exact metrics?

Use relative estimates with qualifiers: "served 10K+ users", "reduced response time by approx. 30%", "scaled to handle 3x traffic", "led a team of 4", "automated a task saving 2 hours/week". If you cannot quantify, use scope: "solely responsible for", "first engineer to build", "end-to-end ownership of". Consistency matters more than precision.

input: What is the best structure for a one-page CV?
output: Top to bottom: (1) header with name, title, email, phone, LinkedIn; (2) 2-3 sentence summary; (3) core skills as comma-separated keywords; (4) experience, most recent first, 3-5 bullets per job with metrics; (5) education at the end; (6) optional certifications. Skip the "References available on request" line. Recruiters decide in about 6 seconds — make your fit obvious immediately.

history.content: What is the best structure for a one-page CV?

Top to bottom: (1) header with name, title, email, phone, LinkedIn; (2) 2-3 sentence summary; (3) core skills as comma-separated keywords; (4) experience, most recent first, 3-5 bullets per job with metrics; (5) education at the end; (6) optional certifications. Skip the "References available on request" line. Recruiters decide in about 6 seconds — make your fit obvious immediately.

ATS systems struggle with tables, graphics, headers/footers and unusual fonts. Use: (1) standard section titles — Summary, Experience, Education, Skills; (2) a single-column layout; (3) standard fonts like Arial or Calibri; (4) spell out acronyms at least once; (5) .docx or PDF (not images). Verify by copying the text back out of the file.

input: How do I add numbers to my CV if I don't have exact metrics?
output: Use relative estimates with qualifiers: "served 10K+ users", "reduced response time by approx. 30%", "scaled to handle 3x traffic", "led a team of 4", "automated a task saving 2 hours/week". If you cannot quantify, use scope: "solely responsible for", "first engineer to build", "end-to-end ownership of". Consistency matters more than precision.

history.content: What is the best structure for a one-page CV?

Top to bottom: (1) header with name, title, email, phone, LinkedIn; (2) 2-3 sentence summary; (3) core skills as comma-separated keywords; (4) experience, most recent first, 3-5 bullets per job with metrics; (5) education at the end; (6) optional certifications. output: ATS systems struggle with tables, graphics, headers/footers and unusual fonts. Verify by copying the text back out of the file.
